query: 物种多样性保护 物种多样性保护 衡量企业对关键物种与生物多样性保护的体系化管理。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：披露了受影响的 IUCN 红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单，设定了明确的种群保护/恢复量化目标，建立了长效监测指标（如物种丰富度、丰度），并与学术机构或 NGO 建立了长期合作机制。 • 1分（合格）：识别了运营区域的敏感物种，有定性的保护措施描述（如避开繁殖期、设置禁猎牌），但缺乏量化的保护目标或系统的长期监测数据。 • 0分（不合格）：无物种保护相关披露，或仅有笼统的“关爱动植物”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：保护机制覆盖 >80% 已识别的生物多样性重点区域、高敏感项目或受影响物种栖息地。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对明星物种（如大熊猫）进行保护而忽略其他受威胁物种，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关信息。 物种保护 敏感物种 受影响物种 国家重点保护物种 IUCN红色名录 受威胁物种 特有种 栖息地保护 繁殖期避让 物种丰富度 物种丰度 生物多样性行动计划 生物多样性监测 环境DNA 红外相机 species conservation sensitive species affected species protected species IUCN Red List threatened species endemic species habitat protection breeding season avoidance species richness species abundance biodiversity action plan BAP biodiversity monitoring environmental DNA eDNA camera traps 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物种多样性保护'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否披露受影响的IUCN红色名录或国家重点保护物种清单？ 是否设定种群保护/恢复量化目标？ 有哪些长期监测指标（如丰富度、丰度）？ 采取了哪些保护措施？ 是否与科研机构或NGO长期合作？ 机制覆盖哪些重点区域或栖息地？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“关爱动植物”；仅有办公室绿植或园区绿化；仅有一般土地复垦而无物种管理；仅有捐赠野生动物基金而无运营影响管理；区分：本指标聚焦关键物种与生物多样性的识别、目标、监测与保护机制；一般环境政策或绿化美化不能替代物种保护体系披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
results.text: Ju Teng International strictly complies with various environmental laws and regulations. On top of that, we established the internal management policies such as the 'Administrative Provisions of Environmental Protection', the 'Accountability System on Environmental Protection', the 'Management of Environmental Incidents' and the 'Environmental Factors and Hazardous Source Management Procedures' to manage possible negative environmental impacts in the production, maintenance, and service process in each Production Plant. All Production Plants of Ju Teng Group have obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems Certification and IECQ HSPM 080000 Hazardous Substance Process Management Systems Certification.

All Production Plants of Ju Teng Group have obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems Certification and IECQ HSPM 080000 Hazardous Substance Process Management Systems Certification.

results.text: Ju Teng International always encourages each Production Plant to fully utilise its own advantages and resources to develop and build new energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant continued to utilise the unused vacant land and roof of the plant for photovoltaic power generation. results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
results.text: In accordance with the 'Energy Conservation Law of the People's Republic of China' and other national and local laws and regulations in the region where we operate, Ju Teng International established and implemented the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedures', which outlines the roles and responsibilities of relevant departments in energy and resource management alongside offering detailed operational rules for energy and resource consumption in the production and operation process. Ju Teng International encourages all Production Plants to manage their targets according to their actual production and operation conditions. By setting specific targets on electricity, water, gas, and energy consumptions, the efficiency on use of natural resources is greatly increased, hence, minimising the negative environmental impacts brought by the Group.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International formulated the 'Environment-Related Substance Reduction Plan Form', which imposes strict requirements on the suppliers to ban the use of heavy metals, formaldehyde, ozone hazardous substances, radioactive substances and so on. In order to restrict suppliers from using prohibited materials or chemical substances in the production process and on the products, parts and packaging materials provided to Ju Teng International, Ju Teng International has signed the 'Environmental Protection Agreement' with suppliers. In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.

In addition, Ju Teng International performs due diligence on the source and chain of custody of the purchased minerals, and requires the suppliers to complete and sign the 'Metal Mineral Origin Survey Form' and the 'Commitment on the Non-use of Conflict Minerals' so that no conflict minerals are used in the production process and on the products. That is, whenever reasonably possible, the products manufactured do not contain minerals such as gold, tantalum, tin and tungsten from armed groups abusing human rights in the Democratic Republic of the Congo or its neighbouring countries/regions.
